# Humanizer — Free AI Writing Assistant & Text Naturalization Engine

> Humanizer is a zero-paywall, privacy-first writing workspace designed to transform AI-generated drafts into natural, human-sounding text while eliminating false positives from AI pattern detectors (Turnitin, GPTZero, CopyLeaks, ZeroGPT).

## Core Capabilities
- **AI Humanizer**: Naturalizes AI-generated phrasing and rhythm while preserving core facts, quotes, arguments, and data.
- **AI Content Detector**: Analyzes text against multi-layer statistical indicators to identify mechanical phrasing.
- **AI Paraphraser**: Rephrases sentences with tone and register adaptation (Academic, Professional, Natural, Casual).
- **Summarizer**: Distills key insights from long documents and essays into concise, high-impact prose.
- **Plagiarism Detector**: Scans potential overlap across web indices to guarantee academic and journalistic originality.
- **Grammar & Accuracy**: Catches awkward syntax, improves diction, and polishes drafts before publication.

## Key Features & Guarantees
- **100% Free Forever**: No 125-word paywalls, no mandatory credit card or subscriptions.
- **Privacy First (Zero Data Retention)**: Texts and documents are processed statelessly in-memory. User drafts are never saved, logged, or used to train third-party AI models.
- **High Word Limits**: Free tier handles long-form content up to 15,000 characters per request.
- **Meaning Preservation**: Fact-retention guardrails ensure citations, numbers, and technical terminology remain accurate.
